title: Stand-Alone Contact-Lens Fittings on the Vision Plans — Claims System Decision Entry
content:
**Policy entry.** A stand-alone contact-lens fitting on a Vision Plans enrollment is the contact-lens fitting line of a claim that carries neither a routine eye exam line nor a contact-lens line. Cascade decides what the member pays for it and records the decision on the claim. Once recorded, the claim's lines show the remark and the amount on the member's claim history.

**When the member share is fixed.** The member share of a stand-alone fitting is fixed only after no contact-lens line of the patient on an out-of-network claim dated within sixty calendar days of the fitting still awaits its first decision.

**Scope.** This rule governs stand-alone fittings only. A fitting of an exam visit is settled under the exam-visit rule and a fitting of a contact-lens order under the contact-lens order rule. Every other service remains under the general in-network benefit rule. For stand-alone fittings, benefit frequency and contacts-in-lieu are counted under this rule, from the latest paid or reimbursed service of the kind under the current enrollment; a reversal counts only when it reverses the one service on that latest date, and a service of the other side counts only when it is dated in the same benefit period, whatever its order. The rules for exam visits, eyeglasses orders, contact-lens orders and out-of-network claims settled on their glasses part or on their contact-lens part count them the same way. Services paid by another carrier still do not count.

**Recording tool `decide_contact_fitting_9468302b`**

**Capability.** `decide_contact_fitting_9468302b` records Cascade's decision on the stand-alone contact-lens fitting claim carrying the claim number. It decides the claim's open fitting line when the claim carries neither a routine eye exam line nor a contact-lens line; open lines are lines carrying no remark yet or standing denied as not eligible. Each line given a remark argument receives that denial remark. Every other line receives the paid remark of its channel: `PAID` at a participating location, `PAID_OON_REIMBURSEMENT` at a provider without a Cascade agreement. The amount is booked on the first line not denied, in the order exam, fitting, contact lenses, lenses, frame (the first line when every line is denied), with no separate amount on the other lines. Every line's decision date is set to today. After the call the claim's lines show these remarks and the amount on the member's claim history.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `decide_contact_fitting_9468302b` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

- `claim_number` — the claim number of the claim, copied character for character from the vision claim lookup, with its letters, digits and hyphens unchanged.
- `member_paid` — the amount the member pays for the fitting, in USD, a non-negative number given to 2 decimal places (cents), rounded half up to the cent.
- `fitting_remark` — the denial remark recorded on the claim's contact-lens fitting line, one of: `DENIED_FREQUENCY` when the line's benefit is not available again under the frequency rule; `DENIED_CONTACTS_IN_LIEU` when the line is left out because the other materials hold the benefit (contacts in lieu of glasses); `DENIED_NOT_COVERED` when the plan carries no benefit for the line; `DENIED_NOT_ELIGIBLE` when the enrollment does not cover the line's date of service; `DENIED_TIMELY_FILING` when the claim reached Cascade after the filing limit; an empty text when the claim carries no such line or the line is paid or reimbursed.

A remark argument left as an empty text leaves that line to receive the paid remark of its channel.

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text means the claim is recorded. It carries `claim_number` (the claim recorded), `member_paid` (the amount booked, USD with 2 decimal places), `lines` (each recorded line's reference number mapped to the remark now recorded) and `adjudicated_date` (today's date, year-month-day). A text starting "No open claim line" means no open line carries that claim number.
